verdict.rationale: Teams channels do support conversation threads (implied by generic docs about conversations and channel messaging, e.g. ms-teams-docs-9, ms-teams-docs-11), but the evidence pack lacks any first-party documentation specifically describing 'reply in thread' functionality, and multiple community reports call out threading as confusing or poorly implemented ('the biggest issue was the threading; it truly beggars belief', 'no threading... inconsistent UI', 'took me long to realise... to follow along the threads'). Missing for 10: explicit product docs/UI walkthrough of thread-reply feature, and independent confirmation that threading works smoothly rather than being a pain point.
